item.description: A flurry of Chinese ships were recently sent to map the seabed in research that Taiwan says aids “battlespace preparation.”

item.title: Oil Prices Rise as Middle East, Ukraine-Russia Conflict Fuel Supply Worries
item.description: Oil prices rose with the market on edge about possible military escalation in the Middle East, while an attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, Houthi claims of more attacks on Saudi refineries and a Ukrainian strike on a Russian refinery fed supply concerns.

item.title: Canada Deems Vancouver Port Expansion a National Priority in Bid to Diversify Trade
item.description: Canada argues that the proposed expansion at the nation’s busiest port is necessary for the country to meet its goal of doubling non-U.S. exports by 2035.

item.title: Ukraine Hits Russian Oil Refinery, Ending Pause and Defying Trump
item.description: The first strike on a Russian oil refinery in two weeks comes after Russian attacks killed 27 civilians on Thursday.
